PMF.deterministicChannel: The deterministic channel associated with f sends input a to the point mass at f(a).
PMF.channelComp: To apply W followed by V, first sample b from W(a), then sample the output from V(b). The resulting law is the row of the composite channel at a.
PMF.channelJoint: Sampling an input A from p and an output B from W(A) gives a joint law on input–output pairs.
PMF.channelExtension: Given the joint law p of (A,B), draw C from V(B). The extended law is the joint distribution of (A,B,C).
PMF.deterministicChannel_apply: At input a, the deterministic channel associated with f produces f(a) with probability one.
PMF.channelComp_apply: For any discrete intermediate alphabet, the mass of c at input a after W followed by V is the sum over all intermediate outcomes b of W(b|a)V(c|b). On an infinite alphabet this is the nonnegative series, with only the supported intermediate outcomes contributing.
PMF.channelJoint_apply: The mass assigned to the pair (a,b) by the channel joint law is p(a) W(b|a).
PMF.channelExtension_apply: Extending p by the channel V assigns the triple (a,b,c) mass p(a,b) V(c|b).
PMF.channelJoint_map_fst: The first marginal of the joint input–output law induced by p and W is p.
PMF.channelJoint_map_snd: The second marginal of the joint input–output law induced by p and W is the output law obtained by passing p through W.
PMF.channelExtension_map_input: For the extension (A,B,C) obtained from p and V, the marginal on the first two coordinates is the original law p.
PMF.channelExtension_map_outputPair: For the extension (A,B,C) obtained from p and V, the law of (B,C) is the channel joint law with input marginal pᴮ and channel V.
PMF.channelExtension_map_output: For the extension (A,B,C) obtained from p and V, the law of C is the output of the channel V with input law equal to the B-marginal of p.
PMF.channelExtension_map_endpoints: In the cascade A ∼ p, B ∼ W(A), C ∼ V(B), the law of (A,C) is the joint law of the input and output of the composite channel.
PMF.bind_channelComp: Passing p through the composite of W and V gives the same output law as passing p first through W and then through V.
PMF.channelComp_pure_left: Putting the deterministic identity channel before W leaves W unchanged.
PMF.channelComp_pure_right: Putting the deterministic identity channel after W leaves W unchanged.
PMF.channelComp_assoc: Cascading W, V and U is associative. Both ways of grouping the three channels give the same channel.
PMF.bind_deterministicChannel: Passing p through the deterministic channel f gives the pushforward of p under f.
PMF.channelComp_deterministic_left: Applying the deterministic map f before channel W gives the row W(f(a)) at input a.
PMF.channelComp_deterministic_right: Applying a deterministic map f after channel W gives the pushforward of the row W(a) by f at each input a.
PMF.channelJoint_deterministicChannel: The joint law of a source with law p and the output of its deterministic channel f is the pushforward of p by a ↦ (a,f(a)).
PMF.channelExtension_deterministicChanne: Extending the pair law p by the deterministic map f on its second coordinate gives the law of (A,B,f(B)) for (A,B) ∼ p.
PMF.mem_support_channelComp_iff: The composite of W and V can produce c from a with positive probability exactly when some b has both W(b|a) > 0 and V(c|b) > 0.
PMF.mem_support_channelJoint_iff: The pair (a,b) has positive mass in the channel joint law exactly when p(a) > 0 and W(b|a) > 0.
PMF.channelJoint_eq_iff_eq_on_support: For the same input law p, two channels induce identical joint laws if and only if their rows agree at every input a with p(a) > 0.
PMF.channelExtension_eq_iff_eq_on_suppor: For a fixed pair law p, two channels extending its second coordinate give identical triple laws if and only if their rows agree on the support of the second marginal.
PMF.mem_support_channelExtension_iff: The triple (a,b,c) has positive mass in the extended law exactly when p(a,b) > 0 and V(c|b) > 0.
